fieldValues.title: Implementor in Semantic records
fieldValues.summary: Someone who implements the SRS specification (the reference implementation or another; the spec maintainer is one version of this person). They rely on the spec, its schemas and its tools agreeing, and on rulings reaching every layer.
goals: Trust that spec, schema and tool say the same thing
See rulings executed in every layer, not parked
Change a record's type without losing its identity
jobs: Implement the spec and its rulings
Keep the implementation conformant as the spec evolves
Keep standards to a size that can be held
fieldValues.needs: One source of meaning, rulings carried into every layer, conformance that can be checked, and change that keeps identity.
